text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It sure was fun. I made so many memories. It was like summer vacation!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: We all tried to make fireworks together, and then Air Groove yelled at us!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: We buried a time capsule, but nobody remembered to write down the location!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: We went into the mountain on a dare, got chased by something, and spent the night trembling in fear in a random hut!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What a summer. It was so fun.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …And the director said such nice things to me too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I still don't know which way I should go or what my goal should be…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But for now, I just want to do my best in the Kikuka Sho! Mun.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right! I actually tried coming up with my own training regimen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: There's also a weight lifting routine I want to try out starting today! Let's have a meeting about it when we get back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems quite motivated for the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Still, isn't everyone running kinda late? I'm sure it's about time to leave…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, I misread the bus schedule. We've still got another hour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At any rate, with the next step in our journey slowly coming into view, this year's summer camp comes to a close.
